title: Trusts (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE TRUSTS ORDINANCE.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Parliament assembled, and by the authority of the same, as follows: - Short title
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Trusts (Amendment) Act, No. 7 of 1968.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Trusts (Amendment) Act, No. 7 of 1968.

body.heading: Amendment of section 21 of Chapter 87
body.raw_text: 2. Section 21 of the Trusts Ordinance is hereby amended, by the substitution, for all the words from " to preclude, in any case ", to the end of that section, of the words " to preclude the deposit of trust money in a Government Savings Bank (including the Ceylon Savings Bank). "
body.text: Section 21 of the Trusts Ordinance is hereby amended, by the substitution, for all the words from " to preclude, in any case ", to the end of that section, of the words " to preclude the deposit of trust money in a Government Savings Bank (including the Ceylon Savings Bank). "
